note: Dispositions for every phrase tools/check-retired-content.py derives from a retired or unobtainable def label. The phrases are DERIVED, never listed here by hand; what lives here is the one judgement that cannot be derived - whether the CONCEPT survived the item. 'stale' means no player-facing string may say it. 'live' means the item went but the thing it named is still real. A new retirement fails the check until its words are dispositioned.

analysis bench.why: the bench is live - a Core research bench designated as the field analysis bench, 0.10.9-dev. Only the custom building went.

field analysis.why: field analysis is what a designated bench still does; the work survived the building.

field analysis bench.why: the full role name is still what a branch designates. RR_FieldAnalysisBench was the custom building, not the job.

control console.why: a gate console is live - a Core comms console designated to a gate, 0.9.0-dev. The custom console went, the role did not.

gate control.why: same as control console: the designated role is live vocabulary.

emergency return.why: an emergency return is a live mechanic with its own window, energy reserve and alerts. Only RR_EmergencyCutoff, the custom switch, was retired.

emergency return cutoff.why: the cutoff was a custom building, retired 0.9.0-dev. A branch uses a Core power switch.

machine gate.why: retired 0.9.0-dev when a gate became a door and nothing else. The vocabulary is 'gate'; only the RR_AssembleMachineGate recipe still carries the old word in its defName.

return beacon.why: retired 0.9.9-dev. The gate's address book and the saved return threshold are the route authority, so the item had no job left.

survey tag.why: retired 0.10.7-dev. Markers are Core glow pods now, and they are still NUMBERED - say 'numbered marker', not 'numbered tag'.

survey tags.why: same item, and the six-per-crew requirement went with it because the owner's direction was not to limit the amount.

sealed evidence case.why: retired 0.10.9-dev. Custody completes at a Shelf designated as the records archive, which is a PLACE rather than an item - so rewording is not enough, the instruction changes.

evidence case.why: same item, and the phrase strings actually used - 'physical evidence case', 'expedition evidence case'.

field recorder.why: superseded 0.12.24-dev. The def stays loadable so old saves open, and is untradeable, unbuilt and ungranted - so nothing should tell a player to use one. Crews write into the record book they carry.

route recording.why: RR_RouteRecording is legacy only - CompRouteEvidence.NativeCarrierDef resolves Core's TextBook, and IsLegacyCarrier exists purely so saves made before that switch keep loading. New evidence is a record book.

utility generator.why: retired 0.9.0-dev. No single Core generator met its 3,500 W, and the vestigial power model went with it; a branch uses Core power.

climate unit.why: RR_SiteClimateUnit was retired; a coordinate uses Core climate equipment.

liminal climate unit.why: same def. Its keyed label survived the def by several checkpoints, referenced by nothing.

fluorescent fixture.why: RR_SiteFluorescent was retired; a coordinate is lit by Core fixtures and glow pods.

liminal fluorescent fixture.why: same def. Its keyed label and description survived the def, referenced by nothing.

faded institutional carpet.why: RR_FadedInstitutionalCarpet was retired; the yellow rooms use Core's CarpetMustard, which 0.12.19-dev finally made them actually use.

gate control console.why: the custom console building was retired 0.9.0-dev. A branch designates a Core comms console, so the ROLE is live vocabulary but this full product name is not.
